description: PAID $0.003 USDC. Use when an agent asks what a company filed recently or wants the latest 10-K/10-Q/8-K link. Optional form filter (comma list) and limit. Returns JSON recent SEC filings for the ticker, with form type and document links.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

form.description: Optional SEC form filter. Format: one form or a comma-separated list. Example: 8-K. The tool text also names 10-K and 10-Q. Omit for every recent form.

limit.description: Maximum filings. Format: positive integer. Example: 10. Omit for the server's current cap.

ticker.description: US stock ticker or SEC CIK. Format: uppercase ticker or numeric CIK. Example: MSFT. Required.

name: stock_filings
title: Recent SEC filings with links ($0.003)
